findings.title: Array index used as key on a removable list with inputs
findings.explanation: Rows contain uncontrolled inputs and can be removed. With index keys React reuses the wrong row, so typed text stays on the wrong item after a removal.

findings.title: Full 50k-row sort on every keystroke
findings.explanation: A comment states `players` holds about 50,000 rows. The sort runs in render and the component re-renders on every keystroke in the search box although the ranking only depends on `players`.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap the sort in `useMemo(() => ..., [players])`, or sort once where the data is loaded.

limitations: Expected result for the evaluation harness; labelled by the maintainers.
